verdict.rationale:
Mastra's workflow engine explicitly persists execution state via storage and snapshots that "capture all the information needed to resume a workflow from exactly where it left off," supporting indefinite pause/resume and even step-level time travel from stored snapshots. This directly matches checkpoint/resume semantics needed after a crash or restart, backed by first-party docs across suspend/resume, snapshots, and time-travel features.

missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically demonstrating recovery after a process crash (vs. planned suspend), and no detail on storage backend guarantees (e.g., durability across restarts of the host process itself).
